_comment: Art styles for the show. Add your own: name + prompt (appended to every image), optional negative, optional lora (a .safetensors filename in ComfyUI/models/loras) + lora_weight. The planning dropdown reads this file.

styles.name: Archer (flat 2D spy)
styles.prompt: in the style of the TV show Archer, flat 2D vector animation, bold black outlines, flat cel shading, limited color palette, mid-century modern, cinematic lighting, clean

styles.name: Modern anime
styles.prompt: modern anime style, clean crisp line art, cel shading, vibrant colors, expressive eyes, studio-quality key visual, detailed background

styles.name: 3D animated (Pixar-like)
styles.prompt: 3D animated feature film style, soft global illumination, subsurface scattering, expressive stylized characters, polished cinematic render

styles.name: Watercolor storybook
styles.prompt: watercolor storybook illustration, soft color washes, visible paper texture, gentle hand-painted look, warm and cozy

styles.name: Inked comic book
styles.prompt: inked comic book art, bold confident linework, halftone shading, high contrast, dynamic graphic panels

styles.name: Claymation
styles.prompt: claymation stop-motion look, sculpted clay textures, handcrafted miniature set, soft studio lighting, tactile

styles.name: Retro 1950s cartoon (UPA)
styles.prompt: 1950s UPA retro cartoon, flat mid-century modern shapes, limited muted palette, stylized angular design, screen-print texture

styles.name: Noir ink wash
styles.prompt: high-contrast black and white noir, heavy ink shadows, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, moody, graphic novel
